clips.title: The story
paras: Ride to the Undercity introduces fledgling Forsaken adventurers to the Horde's aerial flight network across Lordaeron. Carrying weapon requisitions from the embattled outpost of the Sepulcher, couriers take a dread bat directly into the Undercity's Trade Quarter to resupply regional defenders.

Maintaining lines of communication between the Forsaken capital and its frontline outposts requires swift, reliable transit. Karos Razok, the bat handler stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, manages the trained dread bats that ferry messengers and supplies across the plagued landscape. With roads crawling with hostile beasts, Moonrage worgen, and remnants of the Scourge, taking to the skies is the safest and fastest way to ensure urgent military requests reach the capital.

Upon touching down in the Undercity's bustling Trade Quarter, the courier delivers Podrig's equipment requisition directly to Gordon Wendham. As an Undercity weaponsmith dedicated to the Dark Lady's cause, Wendham ensures that regional outposts like the Sepulcher remain outfitted with clean, battle-ready armaments. Sustaining these defensive hubs is vital for the fledgling Forsaken nation as it secures its borders against surrounding enemies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee. Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.
You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. That is the same quarter where my bat will land.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I keep my weapons in top condition. They are cleaned and ready for use.

clips.title: Completion
paras: An order from the Sepulcher? Very well. It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
